label: FP
reason: User input is used in LDAP filter construction but never directly rendered in HTML response. All user-supplied data goes through LDAP directory lookup and is subsequently encoded via ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML() before being written to response. XSS requires unsanitized user input in HTML output.

evidence.note: Response writer prints LDAP attributes (uid/street) after ESAPI encoding, not raw user input
User input incorporated into LDAP filter string (safe for LDAP injection but irrelevant to XSS)
ESAPI encoder applied to all response content preventing XSS
